title: PostReady: PR #490 — Fix: guarantee X posts fit 280 chars (trim at publish + generate to fit)
description: X/Twitter rejects posts over 280 chars for non-Premium accounts. Fixed with a hard trim at publish time and a generate-to-fit mode so ZippityOne captions never exceed the limit. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #489 — Fix: stop wide/vertical outpaint from adding a picture frame
description: Bug fix: prevented the wide/vertical outpaint mode from wrapping generated images in an unwanted picture frame. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #488 — Prompt Studio: reference-image upload (vision) + editable crafted prompt
description: Prompt Studio now accepts a reference image via vision API to inform prompt crafting, and the crafted prompt is fully editable before use. Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #487 — Landing: 'Built for businesses and creators' + creators in audience list
description: Updated landing headline to 'Built for businesses and creators' and added creators to the audience strip. Broader positioning. Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #486 — Video preview: drag-to-reframe within overscan buffer
description: Added drag-to-reframe UX in video preview — users can pan within an overscan buffer to choose the crop before finalizing. Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #485 — Video upload: per-platform preview with UI safe-zone overlays
description: Added per-platform video preview with safe-zone overlay so users see exactly how their video will appear on each target platform before posting. Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #484 — Pricing: Starter 30/5, Pro 60/10, Business unlimited
description: Updated ZippityOne tier quotas in both enforced limits and pricing-page display, kept in sync. Prices unchanged ($49/$149/$279). Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #483 — Hero: fast-rotating 'time back' tagline
description: Added fast-rotating 'time back' tagline below the trust line in the hero section. Copy/animation. Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #482 — Landing: uniform 5-business-card sizing + alignment
description: Made the 5 business cards in the audience section uniform size and aligned. Layout-only fix. Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #481 — Landing: 5-business card strip in audience section
description: Replaced single card in the audience section with a 5-business card strip for richer visual social proof. Layout enhancement. Merged Jul 11.
